Language Movement in Rajshahi: Context and history
2023-02-01T20:55:39+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/language-movement-rajshahi-context-and-history-3236386

Rajshahi's contribution is unforgettable in the history of the Language Movement. After Dhaka, Rajshahi is considered to be the most influential in the movement for several reasons.

After 71 years, we explored the background and history of the movement in Rajshahi in Star Special.
